title.en: Gear mechanism with shafts and bearings

summary: Make a gear pair legible through hubs, shafts, pitch circles, teeth and bearing supports.
objective: A slow full-cycle inspection shows fixed shaft centers and coherent wheel-to-shaft attachment.
example_prompts: Make a gear pair legible through hubs, shafts, pitch circles, teeth and bearing supports.

principles: Distinguish the visible tooth envelope from the ideal pitch circle used by the kinematic model.
Show what rotates together and what holds the axes fixed; an ornamental wheel is not a complete mechanism.
implementation: Separate bearing housing, shaft, hub and rim meshes. Align each rotating group to its shaft axis.
Derive center spacing from declared pitch radii and retain a pitch-circle inspection overlay.
If no validated tooth generator is available, use honest schematic teeth or plain pitch wheels and label the limitation.
observable_checks: A slow full-cycle inspection shows fixed shaft centers and coherent wheel-to-shaft attachment.
The contact-region view either shows meshing teeth without visible interference or clearly identifies schematic geometry.

known_limits: No manufacturing tolerances, involute accuracy, torque transfer or collision dynamics are established.
Authored reusable guidance; no runtime artifact or improvement has been observed for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt proportions, finish and presentation to the scene; explain deliberate departures from this guidance.
